verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own built-in AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts, escalate complex cases to humans, and their decisions can be reviewed or overridden, so the product does ship first-party AI inside its alert and case workflow. That AI is an autonomous triage agent, though, not an analyst-facing conversational assistant. Missing for 10: natural-language querying over fraud/transaction data, AI-drafted monitoring rules, AI-generated investigation summaries, evidence of an interactive assistant UI in the console, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
